entries.zh: 机局——设谋布局（字面：摆布棋局）；亦指棋局阵势
entries.en: to trace/plot; to lay out the chess-board (fig. to lay a stratagem)

entries.zh: 机窍——事情的机窍与关键诀要
entries.en: the hidden key or trick of a matter; all that there is to it
entries.notes: 次字调号污损（T99）且西语释义含删字标记，据「机竅」与 quí quiaũ 定夺。

entries.zh: 窍妙——内中的窍门与奥妙
entries.en: the inner workings or hidden subtlety of a thing (entresý = inward parts)

entries.zh: 设心——心中设谋、存心打算（补注指存坏心）
entries.en: to set one's mind on a thing, to design it in the heart (annotated as ill intent)
entries.notes: 西语词头 traçavertré 涂改难解，mayzita malo 补注提示坏心义，据「設心」与 siẽ̄ sīm 定夺。

entries.zh: 大面旗——大旗；据西语释义指为行骗而张设的大幌子
entries.en: to lay plots in order to deceive; a great banner raised to deceive (lit. 'big face-flag'), a sham
entries.notes: 「大面旗」与『行骗』的习语义关联不明，释义主要依西语 traçar para engañar。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕密谋设诈（首字难辨：嵑/竭，音写不合）
entries.en: to lay plots to deceive (first character doubtful; the phonetic reading does not match either candidate)
entries.notes: 首字[疑:嵑/竭]难辨，且音写 ſū Bōū chūng giōg 与两候选字均不合，仅据西语与「謀」字推定。

entries.en: to lay plots to deceive; to invent a scheme, set a trap

entries.zh: 深谋——深谋远虑、周密的谋划
entries.en: deep plotting; a far-reaching, crafty scheme
entries.notes: 西语释义涂损难解（cöfer bagens para apóco-），据「深謀」与 chīm Bō̄ 定夺。

entries.zh: 用心机——用心计、使心机（或用于好，或用于坏）
entries.en: to use one's wits, to scheme, whether for good or for ill

entries.zh: 传——传下、传续（自祖辈相传）
entries.en: to hand down; tradition (from our elders)

entries.zh: 相传来——相传而来、世代相传
entries.en: handed down by tradition, come down from of old
to hand down and pass on; traditional transmission

entries.zh: 传授——传授（古法亲授、师承相传）
entries.en: ancient received tradition; to impart by instruction

entries.zh: 传流万古——万古流传（相传极古）
entries.en: a most ancient tradition, handed down through all ages

entries.zh: 带——佩带，悬挂颈间随身携带
entries.en: to wear hanging from the neck, to wear about one
entries.notes: 「帶」字调号污损（T99），据汉字与西语 colgado al cuello（挂于颈上）定夺。

entries.zh: 佩——佩挂于腰带（补注：腰带上悬铁铃等物）
entries.en: to wear suspended at the belt; (note:) steel bells hung on the sash… (partly illegible)
entries.notes: 西语补注两处[残]、音写中段污渍且 gio que 两音节与「佩」字不合（或为『玉器』），释义存疑。

entries.en: to carry/transport; luck, fortune (Spanish gloss truncated: 'traer el çedelo…')
entries.notes: 西语释义截断（traer el cedelo[残]，或为 çelo『热忱』）难以对合，据「運」与 ūn 定夺。

entries.zh: 辣——辣、辛辣；引申狠辣（与西语释义难以对合，存疑）
entries.en: hot, pungent (of taste); fierce, ruthless (Spanish gloss garbled — 'crooked legs…' — no clear fit)
entries.notes: 西语释义涂损难解（piernas torcas…），与「辣」义难以对合，据汉字定夺。

entries.zh: 搔——抓挠（首字难辨，或为橈『弯曲』）
entries.en: to scratch (or: to bend), to rub; character doubtful
entries.notes: 首字[疑:橈/搔]难辨，音写 ſo（so/o）更近『搔』，西语短语或含揉搓腿脚之义。
